← Paper Nest 紙材排料

Prototype support / 試作版支援範圍

A browser-based feasibility prototype for paper laser-cutting layouts. Files are processed in this browser and are not uploaded. Refreshing closes the drawing.
用於紙材 laser cut 嘅排料試作版。圖檔只喺瀏覽器內處理，不會上載；重新整理會清除目前圖檔。

Supported / 已支援

  • ASCII DXF: model-space XY geometry, LINE, ARC, CIRCLE and zero-width LWPOLYLINE, including bulges.
    ASCII DXF：Model Space XY 平面直線、圓弧、圓及零闊度 LWPOLYLINE，包含 bulge。
  • AutoCAD GROUP and simple uniformly scaled, unmirrored BLOCK/INSERT. Imported blocks are expanded; exported parts use GROUP.
    AutoCAD GROUP，以及等比、非鏡像嘅簡單 BLOCK／INSERT。匯入 block 會展開；輸出零件使用 GROUP。
  • SVG paths, rectangles, circles, ellipses, lines, polylines, polygons and nested transforms. Explicit dimensions are required; text and styles must be expanded.
    SVG 路徑、基本圖形及巢狀 transform；需要明確尺寸，文字及 styles 請先展開。
  • Closed boundaries assembled from matching endpoints, contained holes and open engraving; explicit groups take priority.
    由相同端點組成嘅封閉輪廓、內部孔洞及開放刻線；指定群組優先。
  • Direct nesting with 1° free rotation or fixed angle constraints. Parts are clustered to preserve a large reusable rectangular offcut. The best validated result appears immediately and remains available for export while improvements continue.
    直接用 1° 自由旋轉排料，亦可限制方向。 零件集中排列以保留大塊長方形餘料；有有效排位即顯示，可即時匯出，並繼續改善。
  • DXF input → DXF or SVG; SVG input → SVG. Sheet guides are excluded from exports.
    DXF 輸入可匯出 DXF／SVG；SVG 輸入可匯出 SVG。板邊預覽線不會輸出。

Before cutting / 切割前

Scale defaults to 100%; choose a uniform percentage when needed. Mirroring is optional and off by default. Each part, its holes, outlined text and engraving transform together. The solver never changes the selected scale automatically.
比例預設 100%，可自行設定等比縮放百分比。 鏡像由用家選擇，預設關閉；零件、孔洞、已轉輪廓文字及刻線一齊變換。 排料不會自動更改所選比例。

Confirm inferred part groups and a known physical dimension. Unsupported content is rejected rather than silently removed. The prototype does not guarantee the mathematical optimum. It does not place parts inside holes, compensate kerf or generate machine toolpaths. A real AutoCAD round trip remains required for production approval.
請核對推斷分組及已知尺寸。不支援內容會拒絕匯入，不會略過。試作版不保證數學最佳解，亦未提供孔內排料、kerf 補償或機器刀路。正式使用前仍需於 AutoCAD 完成實際往返驗證。

Collision curves are approximated to a nominal 0.02 mm tolerance, with additional clearance during nesting. A 0.03 mm edge allowance guards rounding; both allowances increase with drawing enlargement. Supported original DXF curves and original SVG shapes are retained for export. Disconnected explicit groups use a conservative envelope.
碰撞計算曲線使用名義 0.02 mm 精度，排料另加間隙，板邊加 0.03 mm 精度安全量；放大圖形時安全量會相應增加。輸出保留受支援原始 DXF 曲線及 SVG 圖形。不相連嘅指定群組使用保守外邊界。

Limits: 5 MB, 80 parts and 3,000 entities per drawing. Each search has a 20-second improvement budget; a usable result can appear earlier. Continue from the best result, or stop at any time. Objectives, in order: place all parts, minimise sheet count, maximise the primary offcut value (area balanced with proportions), then the second, third and so on. Small fragments cannot compensate for a worse primary offcut value. Equivalent sequences are decided by compactness. A background compaction pass searches contour contact positions inside concave gaps and tries moving pairs together while checking clearances. Pair search uses a bounded candidate beam and time budget. Existing results are replaced only by a better validated result.
上限：5 MB、80 件零件及 3,000 個圖元。每次最多改善 20 秒，有結果即顯示；可隨時停止或承接結果繼續。 依次優先放齊零件、減少板材張數，再按面積與比例嘅綜合價值逐塊比較餘料； 細碎餘料唔能夠抵銷主要餘料價值下降，序列相同時再收緊零件。 背景按真實輪廓搜尋凹位，亦會嘗試兩件一齊重排；雙件搜尋有候選數及時間限制。 每步核對間距，只保留完整而且更好嘅有效結果。

Green rectangles show conservatively estimated clear space within the sheet margin, reserving the selected part gap from contours. Full edge strips are measured directly; other rectangles use a grid with at most 256 cells along the longest sheet edge. Curved and concave boundaries can make this estimate smaller than the true available rectangle. Holes are excluded. Repeatedly reserve the highest-value clear rectangle until none meets the minimum short edge. There is no fixed count. Equal-value positions are compared using subsequent offcuts, retaining up to 32 spatially spread candidates and eight tied continuations. These search limits do not limit the number of offcuts. Both sides must meet the selected minimum short edge (default 20 mm; 0 removes this size filter). No percentage threshold applies.
逐塊找面積與比例綜合最佳嘅長方形，直到冇符合最短邊尺寸嘅餘料，冇固定塊數上限。 同分位置會比較後續餘料；搜尋最多保留 32 個分散候選及八條同分延續路徑，並非限制餘料數目。 兩邊均需達到所選最短邊尺寸（預設 20 mm，0 不限），排料、顯示及匯出使用相同設定。 不使用面積百分比門檻，孔洞不計。 演算法未能證明全域最大餘料，亦未優化任意形狀餘料。

Offcut cutting frames are off by default. Enable “Cut out selected offcuts” to freeze the layout, then select individual rectangles. Downloads include those closed outlines in the green OFFCUT_CUT DXF layer or SVG group. An existing DXF layer with that name is preserved; the new layer gets a numbered suffix. Cutting frames are checked against parts and other selected offcuts before export.
餘料切割框預設唔輸出。 勾選「輸出已選餘料切割框」會固定排位，再逐塊選擇。 下載會包含所選封閉框，放於綠色 OFFCUT_CUT DXF layer 或 SVG group。 若原圖已有同名 layer，新 layer 會加編號，保留原圖設定。 匯出前會核對切割框同零件及其他已選餘料嘅間距。

Offcut proportions / 餘料比例

Offcut proportions balances area with shape. At the default 0.35, narrow strips receive a bounded area discount; a slightly smaller, broader rectangle may win. Zero restores area-only ranking. Sheet count and placing every part still come first. The same preference is used to find the green rectangles and to rank layouts; displayed areas remain real square millimetres.
「餘料長寬比例偏好」預設 0.35，同時考慮面積及比例；幼長餘料會扣分，令稍細而闊身嘅長方形可以勝出。設為 0 回復純面積排序。放齊零件及減少板數仍然優先。綠框提取及排位評分用同一偏好，顯示面積仍係真實面積。

Existing clusters can dock along additional original straight edges, including diagonal edges, while keeping their internal layout. A connected network may exceed the four-part new-assembly limit. All contacts are validated again; common junctions need locally connected, validated shared edges. Unrelated boundaries retain normal spacing.
已有 cluster 可以沿其他原始直邊（包括斜邊）接合，內部排位保持不變；整個連接網絡可以超過四件新組合上限。每次重新驗證接觸，共用交點必須有局部合法共邊連接，其他邊保持正常間距。

Common edges & clusters / 共邊及多件組合

Common-edge nesting permits designated straight boundaries at zero gap; all other boundaries retain normal spacing. Exact diagonal sharing uses the required contact angle, except when rotation is locked. Multi-part search keeps alternative pairs and expands them to three or four original parts. Every accepted move must improve the full sheet score: highest-value reusable rectangle first (area and proportions), then smaller rectangles, occupied extent and cutting cost.
指定直邊可零間距，其他外邊維持正常間距。斜邊按所需角度貼合，鎖定旋轉除外。多件搜尋保留不同 pair，再探索三至四件；每次接受移動都要改善全板評分，依次優先考慮面積與比例綜合最佳嘅餘料、較小餘料、佔用範圍及切線成本。

The search is bounded and cannot guarantee the global optimum. Cluster unions must have one connected exterior without holes; original child geometry and internal holes remain intact. Pierces are a connected-contour lower bound, not a machine cutting schedule.
搜尋有時間及候選數量上限，不保證全局最佳解。組合 union 要係單一連接、冇環形空隙嘅外輪廓；原始零件及內孔保留。穿孔估算只係連接輪廓下限，並非機器切割次序。

Preserve selected remnant split lines protects selected offcut cutting rectangles when tightening an existing layout. Turning it off releases these reservations. Green display rectangles alone are never physical parts. Enable diagnostics before arranging to download candidate generation, rejection and scoring information; detailed events are capped, with aggregate counts retained.
保留分割線會喺繼續收緊排位時保護已選餘料切割框；關閉可釋放呢啲區域。單純顯示嘅綠色框唔會變成實體零件。排料前開啟診斷可下載候選、拒絕原因及評分；詳細事件設上限，總計數保留。

Cut shared sections once is an independent export option. It splits overlapping straight sections in final coordinates and keeps each shared interval once, retaining curves and separate layers. Source polygons remain intact; the exported cutting paths may be open segments. Common-edge endpoints have a local incident-edge run-out allowance. No kerf compensation or piercing order is generated.
「共線段只切一次」係獨立匯出選項；按最終座標拆開重疊直線，只保留共享段一次，曲線及不同 layer 保留。原始 polygon 不變，輸出切線可變成開放線段。共邊端點有局部相連邊豁免；未加入 kerf 補償或穿孔順序。

Open-source credits / 開源鳴謝

Nesting engine: SVGNest, Jack Qiao, MIT. Licence. Its bundled utilities retain their original notices, including Clipper, Parallel.js, SVGPathSeg and geometry utilities.
排料引擎採用 SVGNest；保留所有隨附程式庫嘅授權聲明。

SVG path measurement: path-data-polyfill by Jarosław Foksa, MIT; includes credited path normalisation utilities.

DXF indexed colour table: dxf-parser, MIT. Licence.
